final: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c.gender), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender), shares AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM counts), compared AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS gap_above_average FROM shares) SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, share, gap_above_average FROM compared WHERE gap_above_average > 0 ORDER BY gap_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
